title: Death of the library: A speculative poetic response to the loss of books
abstract: What seemed like a prosaic visit to a newly re-furbished university library, triggered a speculative epiphany of a dystopian possibility. By means of satirical speculative poetry the future of the library and books, as concepts, is explored against the emerging zeitgeist of technopolitical domination by a burgeoning anti-democratic oligarchy. In an original poem called “The Library”, the author’s voice is focalised through the poem’s protagonist, T. L. Robertson, the Western Australian educationalist after whom the library is named. As a fictionalised Robertson visits the library, the subjectivity of the author coalesces with prevailing technoscientific and commercial trends, resulting in an existential pondering of the future of books, knowledge and the relationship of the individual to both. The article considers the synergy of speculative fiction and speculative research as a unifying explanatory paradigms for poetic truth, in which the symbiotic relationship of now-time and future-time is explored.

title: A pilot study on the impact of infection routes on disease progression and immune response by dengue infection in AG129 mice
abstract: AG129 mouse is a mouse model commonly utilised in the study of dengue pathogenesis using various viral inoculation routes. Different viral infection routes may elicit distinct host responses. This pilot study compares the development of dengue virus infection in AG129 mice via intraperitoneal and subcutaneous routes. AG129 mice were infected with dengue virus type 2 (DENV-2) via intraperitoneal or subcutaneous injection. Disease progression was monitored through daily body weight and morbidity scores for 14 days. Plasma viral RNA levels were quantified by reverse transcription-quantitative PCR. Plasma non-structural protein 1 (NS1) level was determined by dengue NS1 antigen- ELISA method. Platelet and blood differential counts were counted. Plasma cytokines were assessed on day 1, 3, 5, and 7 post-infection using multiplex immunoassay. Body weight loss was similar between groups until day 4 post-infection, where intraperitoneally infected mice showed greater loss. Morbidity signs were more pronounced in intraperitoneally infected mice from day 2 to 6 post-infection. Viremia levels detected by NS1 protein and viral RNA were similar between both routes. Intraperitoneal infection triggered an earlier increase in white blood cells and neutrophil counts, as well as earlier lymphocyte reduction and thrombocytopenia. Cytokine analysis revealed early elevations of seven cytokines in in…

title: O'zbekiston hududlarida qurilish materiallariga talab muhiti omillarining panel bahosi
abstract: В статье на панели из 14 регионов Узбекистана за 2019-2025 гг. оценены факторы среды спроса на строительные материалы. Двусторонняя модель с фиксированными эффектами связывает рост строительных работ с динамикой инвестиций, введённой площади жилья, реальных доходов на душу населения и городского населения. Стандартные ошибки кластеризованы по регионам; устойчивость проверена исключением 2020 г. и винсоризацией на уровнях 5-95%. Положительная связь с ввода жилья-площади роста сохраняется во всех спецификациях (β=0,189-0,200; p<0,05). Остальные оценки слабее либо зависят от спецификации. Результаты трактуются как операционные сигналы для производства, инвентаризации и сбытового планирования, а не как доказательство причинного эффекта или прямой эластичности спроса на продукцию.

title: Program Management Functions and Complete Basic Immunization Coverage: A Literature Review
abstract: Complete basic immunization coverage among children is influenced not only by individual and family factors but also by the quality of immunization program management. This literature review aims to analyze the role of program management functions in achieving complete basic immunization coverage. A search was conducted for articles published between 2015 and 2025 using PubMed, Scopus, ScienceDirect, and Google Scholar. A total of 11 articles that met the criteria were analyzed narratively and thematically. The findings were grouped into four main functions: planning; organizing and coordinating; implementation or mobilization of resources; and supervision, monitoring, and evaluation. The review results indicate that data-driven planning, microplanning, cross-actor coordination, capacity building for health workers, logistical support, supportive supervision, data utilization, and tracking of children who have dropped out are associated with improved program performance and increases in various immunization coverage indicators. However, the magnitude of these changes varies across regions, and not all studies allow for causal conclusions. Strengthening management functions as an integrated and adaptive cycle tailored to the local context is necessary to support the improvement and equitable distribution of complete basic immunization coverage.

title: Digital labour and the green transition: heterogeneous environmental effects of platform-based work
abstract: Purpose This study aims to investigate the environmental implications of digital labour expansion and whether the relationship between platform-based digital work and carbon emissions depends on occupational composition and electricity-generation structure. Specifically, it evaluates whether software-task specialisation and fossil-fuel electricity dependence condition the association between online labour intensity and per capita CO2 emissions. Design/methodology/approach The study constructs an unbalanced cross-country panel covering 116 countries over the period 2016–2023 by combining the Online Labour Index with macroeconomic, environmental and electricity-mix indicators from the World Development Indicators. Two-way fixed effects (TWFE) models are estimated to control for country and year heterogeneity. To address dynamic persistence and potential endogeneity, two-step system generalised method of moments (System-GMM) estimations with internal instruments are used. Findings Baseline TWFE results indicate no statistically significant average association between digital labour intensity and per capita CO2 emissions. Once occupational composition is incorporated; however, the interaction between digital labour intensity and software-task share is positive and statistically significant, indicating that the association becomes less negative as software specialisation increases. …

title: Implementation of a Quality Management System in Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises in Solok Regency
abstract: This study aims to describe the implementation of an ISO 9000-based quality management system in Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) in Solok Regency by integrating modern management perspectives and Islamic business ethics. The ISO 9000 standard, developed by the International Organization for Standardization, emphasizes customer focus, a process approach, continuous improvement, and evidence-based decision-making. These principles are conceptually aligned with Islamic values such as itqan (professional excellence and precision), trustworthiness (amanah), and accountability in economic activities, as discussed by Yusuf al-Qaradawi and Al-Ghazali. This research employs a descriptive qualitative approach, using in-depth interviews, observations, and document analysis as data collection techniques. Data were analyzed through systematic stages of reduction, presentation, and conclusion drawing. The findings indicate that MSMEs have substantively applied quality principles through their commitment to maintaining product quality and customer satisfaction. However, the implementation remains informal, lacking structured documentation and standardized written operating procedures. The integration of ISO 9000 principles and Islamic ethical values has the potential to strengthen systematic and sustainable quality governance, ensuring that quality improvement is institutionalize…

title: Qishloq xo'jaligida melioratsiyadan yashil-raqamli transformatsiyagacha: evolyutsion rivojlanish va boshqaruv modeli
abstract: Ushbu maqolada qishloq xo'jaligida melioratsiyaning an'anaviy yer va suv sharoitini yaxshilashga qaratilgan yondashuvdan kompleks meliorativ boshqaruv, barqaror qishloq xo'jaligi, yashil iqtisodiyot va raqamli boshqaruvga qadar bo'lgan evolyutsion transformatsiyasi tadqiq etilgan. Meliorativ tadbirlarning iqtisodiy samaradorligi yer va suv resurslaridan foydalanish, tuproq unumdorligi, ekologik holat va uzoq muddatli barqarorlik bilan o'zaro bog'liq holda asoslangan. Shuningdek, meliorativ jarayonlarni raqamlashtirishda "Dala pasporti", monitoring ko'rsatkichlari, raqamli platformalar, prognozlash va ma'lumotlarga asoslangan qaror qabul qilish mexanizmlarining ahamiyati ochib berilgan. Tahlil asosida melioratsiya, yashil texnologiyalar va raqamli boshqaruvning integratsiyalashuvi natijasida "aqlli melioratsiya" yondashuvini shakllantirish imkoniyati asoslangan.

title: Mehnat resurslarini boshqarishning zamonaviy usullari va ularning iqtisodiy samaradorligi
abstract: Ushbu maqolada kichik biznes korxonalarida xodimlar malakasini rivojlantirishning korxona raqobatbardoshligiga ta'siri tadqiq etilgan. Tadqiqotda xodimlarning kasbiy bilimlari, amaliy ko'nikmalari, raqamli kompetensiyalari va innovatsion salohiyatining mahsulot sifati, xizmat ko'rsatish darajasi, mehnat unumdorligi hamda korxonaning bozor mavqeiga ta'siri tahlil qilindi. O'zbekiston kichik biznesining zamonaviy iqtisodiyotdagi o'rni statistik ma'lumotlar asosida baholandi. Shuningdek, xodimlar malakasini rivojlantirishning korxona raqobatbardoshligiga ta'sirini kuchaytiruvchi tashkiliy va iqtisodiy mexanizmlar taklif etildi. Tadqiqot natijalari kichik biznesda malaka oshirishni oddiy o'quv jarayoni sifatida emas, balki raqobat ustunligini shakllantiruvchi strategik vosita sifatida ko'rib chiqish zarurligini ko'rsatadi.

title: A Comparative Analysis Of Donepezil And Tacrine In The Pharmacological Management Of Alzheimer’s Disease
abstract: This paper examines two medicines on Alzheimer’s disease, donepezil and tacrine, that are both cholinesterase inhibitor drugs. It presents a comparative literature review evaluating their mechanism of action, pharmacokinetic properties, clinical efficacy, safety, and tolerability based on evidence from published clinical studies and articles used to synthesize to evaluate the advantage and limitations for both drugs. This comparison demonstrates that although both medications improve cognitive symptoms by inhibiting acetylcholinesterase, donepezil showcases better selectivity for acetylcholinesterase, longer half life, fewer drug interactions, and a lower risk of hepatotoxicity compared with tacrine. Overall, the findings indicate that donepezil exhibits a significant advantage over tacrine in treatment of Alzheimer’s disease, highlighting the importance of optimizing drug selectivity and safety in the development of medication.

title: Organizational and User Perception Factors Influencing Accounting Information System Effectiveness in Small and Medium Enterprises: A Case Study of Registered Legal Entities in the Songkhla Special Economic Zone
abstract: This study aims to investigate (1) the level of challenges in the use of Accounting Information Systems (AIS) among small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), (2) organizational and user perception factors influencing AIS performance, and (3) the differences in AIS challenges and performance classified by firm characteristics, including business type, number of employees, annual revenue, and duration of AIS implementation. The study is grounded in the Technology–Organization–Environment (TOE) framework and the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM). The sample consisted of 137 SMEs registered as juristic persons in the Songkhla Special Economic Zone. Data were collected using a structured questionnaire and analyzed through descriptive statistics, independent samples t-test, one-way ANOVA, and multiple regression analysis. The findings reveal that SMEs experience AIS usage challenges at a moderate level (x̄ = 2.99), particularly in terms of organizational readiness and support. Meanwhile, the overall AIS performance is rated at a high level ( x̄ = 4.02). The comparative analysis indicated significant differences in AIS challenges and effectiveness among firms with different business types, numbers of employees, annual revenues, and durations of AIS usage. The results of the multiple regression analysis showed that organizational readiness and support, as well as perceived usefulness …

title: StockBingo: A Student-Curated Retrieval Practice Exercise for Management Information Systems Education
abstract: Management Information Systems (MIS) courses introduce students to numerous companies, technologies, strategies, and organizational applications. Students may understand individual examples when presented with them yet struggle to retrieve and integrate them at the end of a semester. This article presents StockBingo, a culminating experiential exercise in which students receive individually randomized bingo sheets containing stock tickers for companies studied during the course and identify firms from instructor- and student-authored clues. Students may collaborate, but each remains accountable for a unique sheet. QR codes enable rapid verification of winning patterns. Students also use expertise developed through a company term paper to propose improved clues for future classes. StockBingo combines retrieval practice, structured gamification, collaboration, individual accountability, and student-generated content in a reusable learning activity.

title: Moliyaviy hisobotlarni qalbakilashtirish xavfi ko'rsatkichlari tizimini ishlab chiqish
abstract: The theoretical and methodological issues of determining the risk of falsification of financial statements during the audit process are studied in the article. The need to move from the unsystematized use of individual signs of fraud to a complex system of interrelated risk indicators was justified. An author's classification of indicators of the risk of falsification of financial statements was proposed, which includes five groups: external, organizational-management, financial, accounting and behavioral indicators. Taking into account the importance and level of manifestation of each indicator, an evaluation procedure was developed, and a formula for calculating the integrated risk index was proposed. Risk classification ranges and corresponding audit activities are defined. Implementation of the proposed system allows formalizing the professional judgment of the auditor, increasing the validity of the assessment of the risk of serious violations caused by dishonest behavior, and providing a more targeted selection of audit procedures.

title: Clinical prognosis and neurosurgical management of abusive head trauma: a scoping review
abstract: OBJECTIVE This scoping review sought to synthesize the current evidence for prognosis and neurosurgical management in abusive head trauma (AHT), a particularly deadly form of pediatric traumatic brain injury (TBI). METHODS Using key search terms such as "abusive head trauma," "neurosurgical procedures," "mortality," and "prognosis," the authors imported articles published between 2009 and 2025 from PubMed, EMBASE, Web of Science, and CINAHL, as well as from citation and gray literature searches of Covidence. Duplicates were removed (n = 3138), and after abstract and full-text screening, 46 articles remained for data extraction. Although these articles addressed more than one category, each was classified according to the primary focus and/or substantive data presented. RESULTS The included studies examined the relative prognosis of AHT relative to accidental trauma (AT) (n = 10 articles), clinical (n = 16) and demographic (n = 8) prognostic factors in AHT, and neurosurgical management of AHT (n = 12). Compared to AT, AHT was consistently associated with greater mortality, longer and more intensive hospitalizations, as well as higher risks of short- and long-term multisystem dysfunction. Among AHT patients, low admission Glasgow Coma Scale scores, abnormal neuroimaging findings, seizures, retinal hemorrhage, respiratory compromise, and abnormal pupillary reactivity were associat…

title: Cognitive knowledge architectures in sustainable supply chains: pathways to organizational performance
abstract: Purpose Supply chain dynamic capability offers significant potential, yet many organizations struggle to leverage it effectively. Grounded in the resource-based view (RBV), this study aims to investigate how organizations leverage sustainable supply chain practices through knowledge-based resources to improve both sustainable performance and human resource (HR) performance. Design/methodology/approach A total of 412 managers and employees from medium and large manufacturing organizations in China were surveyed, and the partial least squares structural equation modeling was used to test the proposed framework for evaluating sustainable practices and dynamic capacities to ensure success in challenging times. Findings Findings indicate that sustainable supply chain management practices exert significant positive effects on both sustainable performance and HR performance. Knowledge sharing and knowledge acquisition partially mediate these relationships, serving as complementary knowledge-based resources that translate sustainability practices into performance outcomes. Practical implications The findings of the study equip policymakers and supply chain managers of manufacturing organizations to provide insights on how to integrate knowledge, enhance decision-making and adopt sustainable operations to enhance the success and sustainability of the operations. Originality/value The st…

title: Machine learning and data-driven models for financial risk and liquidity management in large-scale projects: a systematic review
abstract: Purpose This paper systematically reviews the use of machine learning (ML) and data-driven models in financial risk and liquidity management within large-scale projects, targeting the multifaceted challenges arising from economic, contractual and contextual complexities. This study aims to explore how data-centric approaches can strengthen forecasting, control cash flow volatility and improve resilience across infrastructure, energy and public-sector projects. Design/methodology/approach Following the PRISMA protocol, 142 peer reviewed studies published between 2012 and 2025 were comprehensively screened and analyzed. The sample includes 40 % quantitative, 32 % mixed methods, 16 % literature review and 11 % qualitative designs, demonstrating a balanced methodological landscape. The studies were synthesized across three interrelated domains, i.e. (i) data, (ii) model and (iii) application to capture technical, analytical and contextual dimensions of financial risk management. Findings The reviewed literature reveals clear research concentration patterns, with ML-based models, particularly ensemble methods, neural networks and decision tree algorithms, emerging as the dominant analytical tools, especially in credit risk assessment and related financial decision contexts. Credit risk-related research (30%) dominates the literature, while project-level liquidity remains underexplor…

title: Incidence and Risk Factors for Postoperative Bleeding After Endoscopic Sinus Surgery: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis with Implications for Antithrombotic Management
abstract: Objective: Postoperative bleeding is the most clinically relevant complication of endoscopic sinus surgery (ESS). Although most episodes are minor, severe hemorrhage can occasionally cause emergency visits, readmission, or life-threatening events. This review characterized the incidence, timing, and risk factors for postoperative bleeding after ESS, focusing on antithrombotic therapy, and pooled comparable adjusted effect estimates in a meta-analysis.Methods: This review followed PRISMA 2020 guidelines and was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420261302447). PubMed (MEDLINE) and Scopus were searched for observational studies of postoperative bleeding after ESS. Two reviewers screened studies independently using Rayyan. Risk of bias was assessed with the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale, and adjusted odds ratios were pooled using a random-effects model with the generic inverse-variance method.Results: Twenty studies met inclusion criteria for qualitative synthesis; two provided adjusted estimates for meta-analysis. Postoperative bleeding was reported in fewer than 1% to approximately 5% of patients, depending on study design and definition. Major hemorrhage requiring transfusion or reoperation was rare, occurring in under 1% of cases across large database studies. Antithrombotic therapy, including aspirin and anticoagulants, was the most consistent risk factor, with significantly higher odds o…

Commentary: “Investigating the use of a patient-facing digital app to support Lynch Syndrome carriers in the management of their condition”
abstract: Introduction Lynch syndrome (LS) is an autosomal dominant inherited cancer predisposition syndrome, and the most common cause of inherited colorectal cancers. We conducted a study surveying LS carriers to identify the challenges they face in managing their condition. Based on these insights, we co-developed an app to support LS carriers in staying up-to-date with their management and evaluated if digital solutions could improve care. In this commentary, we explain the rationale behind the app, describe the process of co-development, highlight key findings from the app’s analytics, and outline future directions for the app. Background Although historically considered a rare disease, researchers estimate that LS affects 1 in 400 people, and only 5% of carriers are diagnosed and aware that they have the condition. It requires lifelong surveillance as the risk of cancers including colorectal, endometrial, prostate, and ovarian cancer can be higher than the general population by an average of 56%, 48%, 24%, and 13%, respectively. The UK Cancer Genetics Group (UKCGG) has published management guidelines that recommend, 2-yearly bowel colonoscopy screening, Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) testing, gynaecological reviews for women, aspirin chemoprevention, genetic testing for at-risk family members, and healthy lifestyle advice. title: A GRP hybrid optimization framework with pricing mechanisms for multi-objective EV charging station operation
abstract: Abstract To address the multi-objective optimization of economic performance, grid-load regulation, and environmental performance in electric vehicle (EV) charging-station operation, this paper proposes a Game–Reinforcement Learning–Pareto (GRP) hybrid optimization framework. A Stackelberg game provides the core leader–follower coordination mechanism, while Q -learning and Pareto optimization form two parallel branches for adaptive pricing and economic–environmental balance screening. Seven controlled configurations are constructed to quantify the incremental effects of price response, grid-regulation formulation, dynamic incentives, adaptive pricing, and multi-objective screening under consistent operating conditions. EV behavior is represented by a six-level hierarchical charge-discharge mechanism subject to mobility and battery constraints, together with differentiated incentive mechanisms. Renewable-generation uncertainty is characterized through 500 equally weighted solar–wind scenarios, with a sample-average profile used as a common scheduling input and the full scenario ensemble retained for environmental evaluation. Comparative simulations reveal distinct trade-offs across EV charging cost, operator profitability, grid-load regulation, carbon emissions, and renewable energy (RE) utilization, rather than uniform improvement across all indicators. title: Tijorat banklari raqobatbardoshligini oshirishda strategik boshqaruv mexanizmlarini takomillashtirish
abstract: В статье теоретически и эмпирически исследована роль механизмов стратегического управления в повышении конкурентоспособности коммерческих банков на примере банковской системы Узбекистана. Систематизированы научные подходы, основанные на теории конкурентного преимущества, ресурсной концепции, системе сбалансированных показателей, а также исследования банковской конкуренции и структуры собственности; предложена концептуальная модель влияния стратегического управления на конкурентоспособность банка. На основе данных Центрального банка Республики Узбекистан, Центра экономических исследований и реформ, Всемирного банка и Международного валютного фонда проведён сравнительный и графический анализ структуры собственности, рыночной концентрации, рентабельности, структуры фондирования и показателей цифровизации банковской системы. Результаты показывают, что доля банков с государственным участием в активах снизилась с 84 процентов в 2019 году до 62 процентов на 1 августа 2026 года, а активы частных банков росли быстрее (29 процентов против 14 процентов). Вместе с тем около 85 процентов прироста чистого дохода обеспечено непроцентными доходами, а соотношение кредитов и депозитов в банках с государственным участием составляет 170 процентов. Для коммерческих банков Узбекистана разработана семиэтапная модель совершенствования механизма стратегического управления.

title: LPG Gas Leakage Detection and Control System Using ESP32 with Automated Solenoid Valve and Telegram Integration
abstract: A gas leak is hazardous since it may cause fires, lead to explosions and result in people dying. This is the reason why it is important to have procedures for detecting a gas leak and for stopping it quickly. A smart gas leak system built on the Internet of Things is described in this study. This system is able to detect a gas leak promptly, gives the user an immediate alarm and automatically switches off the gas. It uses an ESP32 microcontroller as its main element. An MQ-2 gas sensor is employed to detect a leak of LPG gas. A relay-controlled solenoid valve is used to stop the gas flow. A buzzer and an I2C LCD display are used to give alarms. A Telegram bot sends messages quickly and enables people to check from a distance. Tests have proved that the system detects gas leaks accurately and reacts swiftly when the gas level goes above the limit. As soon as a gas leak is detected, the system sounds the alarm, closes the valve to stop the further flow of gas and sends a Telegram message. The system offers a real solution for improving gas leak safety by combining instant communication with automatic action. It works well in houses and small factories and can act as a basis for more intelligent gas safety systems in the future.

title: Malignomdiagnostik durch KI-Agenten: Bei Ärztemangel kann ein autonomer KI-Agent das System entlasten
CEO hubris and strategic change initiation: an attention-based view
abstract: Purpose This study aims to examine how chief executive officer (CEO) hubris influences strategic change initiation. Drawing on the attention-based view to complement upper echelons theory, the authors propose that hubristic CEOs, driven by confidence and ambition, selectively focus their attention on strategic opportunities and ambitious actions, thereby increasing the likelihood that firms initiate strategic change. This study further draws on situated attention and structural distribution of attention to examine the boundary conditions of this relationship. Design/methodology/approach The authors collected panel data of S&P 500 firms from 2017 to 2019 and tested the hypotheses using firm fixed-effects models. Findings The results show that CEO hubris is positively associated with strategic change initiation. However, this effect is weakened when top management teams exhibit high uncertainty avoidance or when firms are family-owned. Originality/value This study advances research on CEO characteristics by integrating the attention-based view with upper echelons theory to explain how CEO hubris shapes strategic change initiation through managerial attention allocation. This study also provides a better understanding of the boundary conditions that influence hubristic CEOs’ attention to organizational strategic change initiation.

title: A nomenclatural system for class-series zoological nomina. 4. Basic requirements for class-series nomenclature
abstract: This paper continues our reflection on a project of a comprehensive system of Rules for class-series nomenclature complementary to those of the current Code. We think the new Rules should follow the same basic principles, criteria and requirements as the Code itself. We distinguish four main categories among these basic characteristics: [1] the Rules of the Code are strictly nomenclatural, not taxonomic; [2] following strictly these Rules is compulsory for Code-compliance; [3] these Rules respect a few general conventions and 18 basic Principles; [4] their implementation follows a well-defined Nomenclatural Process composed of several stages, here re-examined and reformulated. The fact that our scientific inventory of biodiversity is dramatically incomplete, while irreversible extinctions are raging and will result in considerable and definitive losses in our knowledge about diversity, imposes on taxonomists the need to make the right choices concerning the hierarchy of their priorities in this domain. We think that any system for higher zoological nomenclature should respect these specifications and allow to keep unchanged the most familiar class-series nomina, applying to well-known taxa, while furnishing strict and automatic Rules for establishing the valid nomina of all other taxa, without having to embark on sterile and endless discussions based on complex theories, opinio…

title: Wholesale Vegetable Price Profiles in Assam Using Nearest Neighbour and Average Linkage Clustering
abstract: Aims: To identify interpretable combinations of everyday wholesale vegetable prices in Assam and compare nearest-neighbour and average-linkage clustering. Study Design: Exploratory observational study using publicly available secondary market quotations. Place and Duration of Study: Sixteen reporting markets in Assam, India, from January to September 2026. Methodology: The dataset contained 612 complete market–day observations of modal prices for potato, brinjal, tomato and cabbage. Prices were converted to rupees per kilogram and standardised. Single-linkage and average-linkage solutions with two to six groups were assessed. Supplementary checks used internal validation indices, 100 markets–week block subsamples, an unusual-quotation sensitivity refit and 135 weekly profiles. Results: Single linkage showed pronounced chaining. Four-group average linkage produced groups of 394, 47, 169 and two observations, with a mean silhouette width of 0.428. The 169-observation group combined lower potato prices with higher brinjal, tomato and cabbage prices. Two groups achieved a higher silhouette of 0.599 but chiefly isolated two unusual potato quotations. Block subsampling gave a median adjusted Rand index of 0.892, with an interquartile range of 0.407–0.926. Weekly four-group clustering had a silhouette width of 0.448, although a singleton remained. Conclusion: Average linkage provides …

title: محددات أسعار الأسهم للبنوك الإسلامية الكويتية خلال الفترة (2016- 2025)
abstract: تتمثل الفجوة البحثية في محدودية الدراسات التي تناولت بصورة متكاملة أثر المحددات المالية الداخلية والمتغيرات الاقتصادية الكلية في أسعار أسهم البنوك الإسلامية الكويتية. لذلك هدفت هذه الدراسة إلى قياس أثر محددات أسعار الأسهم في البنوك الإسلامية الكويتية خلال الفترة (2016–2025). واعتمدت الدراسة على المنهج الوصفي لتحليل الجوانب النظرية، والمنهج التحليلي باستخدام بيانات بانلية (Panel Data)، كما استُخدم نموذج التأثيرات الثابتة (Fixed Effects Model) بوصفه النموذج الأنسب لتحليل العلاقة بين متغيرات الدراسة. وأظهرت النتائج أن نمو عرض النقد كان المتغير الوحيد ذو الأثر المعنوي في أسعار الأسهم، إذ بلغ معامل الانحدار (β = -9.202) عند مستوى دلالة إحصائية (p = 0.002)، بما يشير إلى وجود أثر عكسي معنوي، في حين لم تظهر بقية المتغيرات، وهي العائد على الأصول، ونسبة الودائع، والقيمة الدفترية للسهم، ومعدل نمو الناتج المحلي الإجمالي، ومعدل التضخم، أي أثر معنوي. وتؤكد الدراسة أن المتغيرات النقدية تمثل المحدد الأكثر تأثيراً في أسعار أسهم البنوك الإسلامية الكويتية، بما يسهم في إثراء الأدبيات المتعلقة بمحددات أسعار الأسهم في القطاع المصرفي الإسلامي، ويدعم متخذي القرار والمستثمرين في بناء قراراتهم الاستثمارية على أسس علمية.

Forecasting Next-Day TLKM Stock Prices Using Linear and Nonlinear Machine Learning Models: A Case Study of PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk
abstract: Stock price forecasting provides useful information for investors in making decisions in fluctuating capital markets. The objective of this work is to develop and compare models to forecast the closing price for the next trading day. Three models were employed: linear regression, an optimized random forest regression, and an optimized backpropagation neural network. The dataset used consists of daily market data for TLKM and IHSG covering the period from March 22, 2018, to February 24, 2027. The predictors used include open price, high price, low price, trading volume, SMA5, and RSI14, while the target variable is the next day's TLKM closing price. The dataset was divided chronologically into 80% training and 20% testing sets. Time-series cross-validation was performed using 5-fold TimeSeriesSplit. Hyperparameter optimization was applied to the random forest and backpropagation neural network models using RandomizedSearchCV. The results show that linear regression outperforms the other models based on the overall evaluation metrics, with an MAE of 57.67, RMSE of 81.38, MAPE of 1.37%, and of 92.8%. The MAPE value indicates that the linear regression model has a relatively low forecasting error. The linear regression model can also explain approximately 92.8% of the variation in the next day's TLKM closing price through the predictors included in the model. The implication of thi…

title: Application of Transformer Model in Predicting Housing Price in Selected Vietnamese Provinces
abstract: This paper selects an appropriate machine learning model to forecast real estate and apartment prices across several major provinces and cities in Vietnam. While we primarily deploy the Transformer, we also experimented with other machine learning algorithms, such as Linear Regression, Decision Tree, and Random Forest, to demonstrate the Transformers superior performance. We automatically collected raw data from Vietnams largest real estate website and then preprocessed, analysed, and evaluated it. The analysis revealed that building a prediction model on a single dataset yields fewer effective results than splitting the data into two distinct sets, one for landed properties and the other for apartments, and developing separate models for each product category. Building two independent prediction models allows effective use of each product types unique characteristics, improving the accuracy and efficiency of machine learning for real estate price prediction.

title: Dynamic modelling and forecasting of interest rates: evidence from Scandinavian countries
abstract: Purpose Using unique data of three Scandinavian countries (Denmark, Norway and Sweden), the study examines the term structure of their interest rates and the performance of the Babbs and Nowman model in forecasting the rates covering their economic stability and financial crisis periods from 2000 to 2014. Design/methodology/approach The continuous-time multi-factor model developed by Babb’s and Nowman (1999) is employed for the research alongside the state-space form (TSIR) of the model. The linear Kalman filter algorithm is further implemented to produce the estimates for both the observable and unobservable variables. The dataset used in the study enables a critical assessment of the in-sample and out-of-sample performance across three versions of the multi-factor Babbs and Nowman model. Findings The research shows that the complexity of the three-factor model is necessary to better explain the yield curve dynamics in the case of Denmark and Norway, while for Sweden there is no clear benefit in adding a third factor. However, under the best predictive specification, the out-of-sample analysis produced different results for each country. The findings further exhibit that when considering the forecasting errors, the continuous-time models generate superior forecasts, a feature of great interest in pricing interest rate derivatives and hedging strategies. Research limitations/im…

LARVA-Net: A Bio-Inspired Recursive Attention Model for IoT-Based Microclimate Prediction in Black Soldier Fly Insectariums
abstract: Microclimate prediction is critical for optimizing larval growth and productivity in Black Soldier Fly (BSF) insectariums, where temperature and humidity exhibit nonlinear and time-varying dynamics. Conventional models such as Vector Autoregression (VAR) and Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference Systems (ANFIS) often struggle to balance accuracy, efficiency, and interpretability in IoT-based environments. This study proposes LARVA-Net, a bio-inspired recursive attention framework for multivariate microclimate prediction in BSF insectariums. LARVA-Net integrates a VAR-based linear baseline with selective recursive attention and adaptive fuzzy-state learning. The bio-inspired aspect represents a computational abstraction of adaptive and energy-efficient information processing observed in larval behavior, rather than a biological simulation. By selectively updating internal states based on contextual relevance, the model suppresses error accumulation while maintaining interpretability and stable learning. The proposed method is evaluated using real-world IoT microclimate data collected from a semi-controlled BSF insectarium. Experimental results show that LARVA-Net outperforms VAR, ANFIS, and VARFIS, achieving an RMSE of 0.2440, MAE of 0.1466, MAPE of 0.4566%, and R² of 0.9911. These results demonstrate strong predictive performance and robustness under time-aware evaluation, indicating …

Link prediction for static knowledge graphs based on attention mechanism and deep graph propagation
abstract: Abstract The ongoing expansion of application scenarios for knowledge graphs enhances the research significance of link prediction. Current graph neural network methodologies utilized for link prediction on static knowledge graphs frequently suffer from node feature over-smoothing and information degradation in deeper layers, hindering the comprehensive utilisation of structural patterns and semantic relationships within the graphs. This study aims to overcome these limitations by focusing on the static knowledge graph completion problem and proposing a link prediction method that incorporates attention mechanisms and deep graph propagation. This method enhances the efficacy of link prediction by optimising semantic graph representations and analysing entity relationships. This paper’s primary contribution is a sophisticated graph propagation model called Multi-Head Attention and Dynamic Pruning Graph (MADPGraph), designed for static knowledge graph link prediction, integrating multi-head attention relation-aware modules and dynamic pruning techniques. The approach initially creates query-oriented subgraphs to encapsulate multi-hop neighbourhood contextual information focused on head entities. A relation-aware multi-head attention technique aggregates query relations, edge relations, and node features, enabling deep information propagation across multiple attention heads. An in…

title: Machine learning-based prediction of wear rate in TiB 2 and ZrC reinforced LM13 hybrid metal matrix composites
abstract: Abstract Accurate wear rate prediction is crucial for designing aluminium composite components for automotive applications. Most studies rely on response surface methodology (RSM), whose polynomial structure cannot adequately capture nonlinear tribological behaviour. To address this limitation, random forest (RF), artificial neural network (ANN), and support vector machine (SVM) with a radial basis function (RBF) kernel were applied to an experimental dataset of 20 trials and compared with the established RSM model. All three machine learning (ML) algorithms outperformed RSM. The ANN agreed most closely with experimental data, with a coefficient of determination ( R 2 ) of 0.9861, root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.000231 g mm −1 , and mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.000187 g mm −1 , followed by SVM ( R 2 = 0.9803) and RF ( R 2 = 0.9724). RF feature importance scores confirmed the analysis of variance (ANOVA) parameter ranking from previous work, with sliding speed the most influential factor. ANN prediction errors against confirmation experiments remained around 2.5 %. ML-based wear prediction offers a more accurate and viable alternative to RSM for hybrid metal matrix composites in automotive design and service life estimation. However, the 20-run dataset limits the results to a proof of concept for this composite system rather than general-purpose wear prediction.

title: Machine Learning Weather Prediction: Models, Verification and Limits
abstract: Between 2022 and 2025 a series of neural networks trained on four decades of reanalysis data began to match, and on many headline scores to beat, the best physics-based global weather forecasts, at a small fraction of the running cost. This review describes that change for an information technology readership and reports no new experiment. We begin with the numerical baseline and the ERA5 reanalysis on which nearly all of the models are trained. We then follow the deterministic models built on convolutions, neural operators, transformers and graph networks, the probabilistic and hybrid systems that came after them, and precipitation nowcasting from radar and satellite as a neighbouring problem. Benchmarks and published scores are then set beside the critical studies, which found forecasts that blur as lead time grows, weak physical balance at small scales, missing error growth from tiny perturbations, underestimated wind peaks in individual storms and poorer skill on record-breaking extremes. The same body of work also found realistic dynamical behaviour, and we report both sides. Compute cost, explainability and the dependence on numerical analyses for training and initial states close the review.
venue: International Journal of Information Technology Research Studies (IJITRS)

title: Comparative Analysis of GridSearchCV and RandomSearchCV for LightGBM-Based Stunting Prediction Using (MICS6) Bangladesh 2019 Data
abstract: Stunting among children under five is a major public health concern that can impair physical growth and cognitive development. This study evaluates and compares GridSearchCV and RandomSearchCV for hyperparameter tuning of the LightGBM algorithm in predicting stunting using data from the Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys (MICS6) Bangladesh 2019. The dataset comprises demographic and child health variables, and model performance was evaluated using training-to-testing ratios of 70:30, 80:20, and 90:10. Accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and execution time were used as evaluation metrics. The results showed that the 90:10 split yielded the best overall performance. Among the evaluated configurations, LightGBM with RandomSearchCV achieved an accuracy of 98.09%, precision of 95.93%, recall of 97.08%, and an F1-score of 96.50%, with a reported execution time of 0.1 seconds. Compared with the untuned model, hyperparameter tuning provided only marginal improvements in classification performance, while RandomSearchCV offered a favorable balance between predictive performance and computational efficiency. These findings demonstrate the potential of LightGBM-based stunting prediction using (MICS6) Bangladesh 2019 data. However, further evaluation using independent datasets is necessary to assess the model's generalizability and its potential application in early stunting detection.

title: Revisiting Conventional Models of Electoral Prediction: Insights from Nigeria's 2023 Presidential Election
abstract: Although electoral forecasting has received considerable scholarly attention, research systematically reassessing conventional prediction methods in relation to Nigeria’s electoral volatility, social media dynamics, and ethno-regional complexity remains limited. This study revisits opinion polls, historical voting patterns, and expert assessments in Nigeria’s 2023 presidential election and examines how social media sentiment can complement these approaches. A qualitative case study design was employed, drawing on eleven major pre-election polls, official results from the Independent National Electoral Commission, secondary sentiment-analysis datasets, and documentary sources. Comparative and thematic analyses were used to examine forecasting performance and identify methodological and contextual explanations for observed discrepancies. Conventional methods performed unevenly, with a reported failure rate of 63.6% among the eleven polling organisations reviewed. The analysis linked these shortcomings primarily to urban-centred sampling, inadequate turnout modelling, and insufficient attention to ethno-regional and religious cleavages. Approaches incorporating historical voting behaviour, turnout scenarios, and structural variables demonstrated greater predictive accuracy. Twitter sentiment provided timely indications of electoral competitiveness, although its contribution depend…

title: Mathematical Modelling of Environmental Pollution Dynamics: From Contaminant Transport to Ecological Risk Prediction
abstract: Environmental pollution is complex because contaminant transport, chemical transformation, environmental compartments, biological processes, and human activity interact. Mathematical modelling describes these processes and can predict pollutant fate, forming the basis for quantitative ecological risk assessment. This review considers mathematical methods for characterising the spatial and temporal dynamics of environmental contaminants in soil, water, sediment, and atmosphere. It focuses on differential equation modelling, advection–dispersion equations, reaction–transport modelling, compartmental modelling, stochastic modelling, and numerical simulation techniques. It critically assesses the mathematical representation of contaminant sources, movement, adsorption/desorption, degradation, bioaccumulation, and transformation. The discussion focuses on using models to generate pollutant concentration gradients and exposure pathways for ecological risk estimation and environmental management. The review also considers uncertainty and sensitivity analyses as key tools for assessing model reliability and identifying the parameters that most influence environmental outcomes. It also examines optimisation approaches for remediation planning, including source control, contaminant removal, biodegradation, and treatment allocation. The review discusses emerging AI and machine learning ap…

title: Dynamic Mathematical PDE Modeling and Machine Learning for TANGO2 Identification and Crisis Prediction
abstract: TANGO2 (Transport And Golgi Organization 2) deficiency disorder (TDD) is a rare autosomal recessive condition marked by unpredictable, life-threatening metabolic crises, including rhabdomyolysis, cardiac arrhythmias, and metabolic encephalopathy. Supportive treatment, particularly B-complex vitamin supplementation and fasting avoidance, substantially reduces the frequency and severity of crises, so undiagnosed patients remain at the greatest risk. This work presents a two-stage framework that couples supervised machine learning classification with numerical simulation of a stochastic partial differential equation (PDE). The first stage identifies TDD patients from their stable baseline presentation, and the second models future crisis behavior as a threshold-crossing dynamical system. Using deidentified Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) profiles from 90 molecularly confirmed TDD patients and 141 diagnosed Undiagnosed Diseases Network (UDN) controls, we exclude all 23 crisis-defining phenotypes and restrict the primary analysis to the 30 HPO terms recorded by both annotating teams, so that classification depends only on information available before a crisis. A Random Forest classifier, evaluated by repeated stratified tenfold cross-validation, attains an AUC of 0.993 (variance-corrected 95% interval 0.980 to 1.000), with 95.6% sensitivity and 100% specificity. The result withstands…

title: Prediction of shear contribution of fibre-reinforced polymer-strengthened reinforced concrete beams using machine learning
abstract: Machine learning (ML) techniques are widely used for reliable forecasting of the shear strength contribution of fibre-reinforced polymer (FRP)-strengthened reinforced concrete beams. However, the shear behaviour of beams strengthened by FRP that have low shear span-to-effective depth ratios (av/d), as well as the interaction between vertical steel shear reinforcement and FRP strips, cannot be well explained by the research that is currently available in the literature. This study provides five supervised ML algorithms (ridge regression, random forest, support vector regression, extreme gradient boosting and categorical gradient boosting (CatBoost)) to address this gap. A comparative analysis was conducted using three existing analytical models and three established standard guidelines to prove the reliability of ML models. Grubbs’ test with median imputation was used for outlier detection, followed by robust scaling to ensure data consistency. A Shapley additive explanations-based feature importance plot was implemented to interpret the influence of individual parameters on the FRP shear contribution (Vf). The results demonstrated that CatBoost achieved the highest accuracy levels for FRP shear-contribution predictions (R = 0.96; mean absolute error = 13.70 kN; mean absolute percentage error = 18.07%; root mean square error = 21.80 kN; and Nash–Sutcliffe efficiency = 0.92).

abstract: The article scientifically substantiates the difference between project profitability and debt servicing capacity in the financial assessment of infrastructure investment projects. The functions of net present value, internal rate of return, cost of capital and debt service indicators are compared and a procedure for their consistent application is proposed. The importance of scenario analysis and the risks of double counting in the assessment are shown

title: Green energy transition in central asia: capacity growth, technological diversification and system constraints
abstract: This study reassesses the green-energy transition in Kazakhstan, the Kyrgyz Republic, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan using the latest harmonised capacity data available in 2026 and a structured review of 17 Scopus-indexed studies published in 2020-2026. The empirical design separates scale, speed and technological composition rather than treating installed renewable capacity as a single measure of transition maturity. Three indicators are calculated for 2023-2025: compound annual capacity growth, each country's contribution to regional capacity additions, and a technology-concentration index based on hydropower, solar and wind shares. Regional renewable capacity rose from 17.636 GW in 2023 to 25.482 GW in 2025, an increase of 44.5%. Uzbekistan accounted for 86.4% of the net regional addition and reached 10.027 GW, while solar and wind represented 75.6% of its renewable portfolio. Kazakhstan retained the most technologically balanced portfolio, whereas the Kyrgyz Republic and Tajikistan remained strongly hydro-dependent. The results show that capacity expansion and transition quality are analytically distinct. A durable transition requires grid reinforcement, storage, flexible dispatch, competitive procurement, credible investment rules and regional electricity exchange. The article proposes a system-value framework in which new renewable capacity is evaluated by delive…

Cooling Load Analysis and AC Capacity Selection in Low Voltage Medium Distribution Panel Room in Building X Jakarta
abstract: This study analyzes the cooling load of the Low Voltage Main Distribution Panel (LVMDP) in Building X, Jakarta. The LVMDP room as the building's electrical distribution center requires a temperature of 21–24°C and a humidity of 40–60% to prevent overheating. The actual temperature reached 31.3°C, far above the ASHRAE standard, while the installed AC capacity was only 3.5 PK. The objectives of the study were to determine the main heat source, calculate the total cooling load, and recommend the appropriate split AC capacity. The method used was an applied descriptive quantitative method with Cooling Load Temperature Difference (CLTD) calculation referring to the ASHRAE Handbook 1997. Primary data were obtained from direct measurements of room dimensions, temperature, humidity, panel electrical current, existing AC specifications, lighting, and personnel interviews. Load components include wall conduction, roof, doors, lighting, personnel, LVMDP panels (2% power loss), and infiltration (ACH=0.5). A 10% safety factor was applied according to ASHRAE. The results showed that the most significant heat sources were the LVMDP panels (45.4% or 6,928 W) and the roof of the room (37.4% or 5,136 W). The total cooling load without infiltration was 15,252 W (59,840 BTU/h), while with infiltration it was 18,647 W (73,166 BTU/h). After the safety factor, the AC requirement without infiltration …

title: From measurement to financing: Social public investment, fiscal capacity and the multidimensional poverty–SDG nexus in Latin America and the Caribbean — A dynamic panel analysis, 2008–2022
abstract:
The measurement of multidimensional poverty in Latin America and the Caribbean has matured
considerably, yet the financing question — how much social public investment is required, and under

title: Marine Ecotourism Suitability, Carrying Capacity, and Development Prospects at Pink Beach, East Lombok
abstract: Pink Beach, located in Sekaroh Village, Jerowaru District, East Lombok Regency, Indonesia, is characterized by pink sand, scenic seascapes, and potential for swimming, snorkeling, and beach recreation. Tourism planning requires an assessment of site suitability and estimated visitor capacity to support appropriate management. This study aimed to assess tourism suitability using the Tourism Suitability Index (TSI) and estimate the carrying capacity of tourism activities at Pink Beach. The research was conducted in August 2026 using a descriptive quantitative approach involving field observations, environmental measurements, and interviews with 25 respondents. Observations were conducted at three stations approximately 100 m apart. The TSI values were 2.98 at Station 1, 2.82 at Station 2, and 2.68 at Station 3, with a mean of 2.83, placing all three stations in the highly suitable (S1) category. The estimated theoretical carrying capacities were 234 visitors per day for swimming, 38 for snorkeling, and 33 for beach recreation, giving a combined estimate of 305 visitors per day. Of the total reported land area of 169,545 m², 25,224 m² (14.88%) was reported as utilized for tourism. In the marine area, 10,275 m², equivalent to 50% of the reported 20,550 m² area, was utilized for tourism activities. These area estimates describe reported spatial utilization and do not independently e…

title: Intensiv bog'dorchilikni modernizatsiyalashning resurs-integratsiyalashgan mexanizmi
abstract: Maqolada Jizzax viloyatida intensiv bog'dorchilikni modernizatsiyalashning mavjud holati va 2026-2030 yillarga mo'ljallangan rivojlanish prognozlari tahlil qilingan. Intensiv bog'zorlar maydonining tumanlar kesimidagi dinamikasi asosida resurslarga bo'lgan ehtiyoj va ulardan samarali foydalanish masalalari asoslangan. Intensiv bog'dorchilikni modernizatsiyalashda moliyaviy, suv, energetik, moddiy-texnika va texnologik resurslarni yagona qiymat zanjiri asosida muvofiqlashtirishga qaratilgan resurs-integratsiyalashgan mexanizm taklif etilgan.

title: Xususiy tibbiy xizmatlar raqobatbardoshligini oshirish iqtisodiy mexanizmi amal qilish tamoyillari
abstract: Maqolada xususiy tibbiy xizmatlar raqobatbardoshligini oshirish iqtisodiy mexanizmining amal qilish tamoyillari nazariy-uslubiy jihatdan tadqiq etilgan. Tibbiy xizmatlar bozorining axborot assimetriyasi, ijtimoiy ahamiyati, sifatni oldindan baholash murakkabligi va davlat tomonidan tartibga solish zarurati kabi xususiyatlaridan kelib chiqib, iqtisodiy mexanizmning umumiy bozor tamoyillarini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qo'llash yetarli emasligi asoslangan. Mualliflik yondashuvida bemor uchun qiymat yaratish, sifat va xavfsizlik ustuvorligi, iqtisodiy manfaatdorlik, narx-natija mutanosibligi, raqobat neytralligi, axborot shaffofligi, innovatsionlik, resurs samaradorligi, institutsional muvofiqlik, javobgarlik va adaptivlik tamoyillari yagona tizimga keltirilgan. Tamoyillarning iqtisodiy mazmuni, amal qilish vositalari va raqobat natijasi o'rtasidagi bog'liqlik ochib berilgan.

title: Davlat-xususiy sheriklik asosida ijtimoiy soha infratuzilmasini rivojlantirishda "value for money" (VfM) baholash mexanizmini takomillashtirish
abstract: This article investigates the theoretical, methodological, and practical dimensions of the 'Value for Money' (VfM) assessment methodology in delivering social infrastructure (education, healthcare, public utilities) through Public-Private Partnerships (PPP). Comparing standard procurement models via the Public Sector Comparator (PSC) benchmark against PPP alternatives represents a cornerstone in ensuring fiscal prudence and optimizing lifecycle expenditure. Drawing on recent social infrastructure modernization initiatives in Uzbekistan, the paper evaluates current qualitative and quantitative VfM practices. Furthermore, based on international best practices, comprehensive policy recommendations are provided to enhance project selection, standardize appraisal frameworks, and elevate public service quality.

title: Buxoro viloyati savdo korxonalari raqobatbardoshligini oshirishda marketing mexanizmini takomillashtirish: raqamli imkoniyatlar va xorijiy tajriba
abstract: The article analyses the competitive environment of trade enterprises in the Bukhara region using official statistics for 2015-2024, assesses the contribution of digital infrastructure to trade development and summarises foreign experience in improving the marketing mechanism in the trade sector. The study applies CPI-based deflation, compound annual growth rates, elasticity estimation, correlation analysis and the first-difference method. The volume of trade services grew 6.6-fold in current prices and 2.5-fold in real terms (10.9% per year), while real growth slowed from 22.3% in 2016 to 5.4% in 2023. The elasticity of trade with respect to gross regional product equals 1.05, indicating that growth was driven mainly by overall economic expansion. The strong correlation between internet coverage and real per capita trade (r = 0.99) is not confirmed in annual changes, suggesting that digital infrastructure does not by itself translate into competitive advantage. Based on the experience of South Korea, Singapore, Germany, China and India, directions for improving the marketing mechanism of the region's trade enterprises are proposed.

abstract: В статье исследованы вопросы совершенствования организационно-экономического механизма эффективного использования цифрового маркетинга в повышении конкурентоспособности торговых услуг. Проанализированы официальные статистические показатели торговли Узбекистана за 2025 год, доля электронной торговли в розничном товарообороте и динамика цифровой аудитории. Разработана модель механизма, состоящая из пяти блоков (организационно-управленческий, экономико-финансовый, технолого-инфраструктурный, маркетингово-коммуникационный, кадровый); значимость блоков оценена методом анализа иерархий (CR = 0,003). Предложены интегральный индекс вклада цифрового маркетинга в конкурентоспособность (IRMRI) и уровни цифровой зрелости торговых предприятий, обоснован трёхсценарный прогноз объёма электронной торговли до 2030 года.

title: Fear, Fatalism and Avoidance: An Affective-Appraisal Extension of Realist Context–Mechanism–Outcome Reasoning for Digital Dementia Risk-Reduction Education
abstract: Dementia risk-reduction education is increasingly accessible online, but access to information does not necessarily translate into engagement or action. Dementia is widely feared, and for some people, information about their own risk may generate responses that discourage rather than encourage further engagement. This conceptual paper extends an existing realist framework for digital dementia education [1], which conceptualises emotion as a contextual moderator, by proposing emotional appraisal as a mechanism through which educational information may influence engagement and behavioural readiness. Synthesising the realist evaluation framework established by [2], with appraisal theory and existing literature on dementia anxiety, this paper proposes four evaluative appraisals: perceived threat, perceived controllability, fatalism, and stigma. These appraisals are proposed to shape three observable response patterns: approach, ambivalence, and avoidance. Within the proposed framework, emotional appraisal is positioned between interpretative engagement and behavioural readiness, while avoidance may subsequently feed back to reduce future engagement with dementia education. Four context–mechanism–outcome configurations are proposed, including two in which emotional appraisal contributes to disengagement, together with five propositions that can be examined empirically. The framework…

title: A Socio-Legal Analysis of Normativizing Maja Labo Dahu in Regional Lawmaking: A Proposed Hybrid Sanction Mechanism in Bima, Indonesia
abstract: The incorporation of local wisdom into regional legislation remains underexamined in Indonesia, particularly when moral-spiritual philosophies must be translated into clear, enforceable, and rights-compatible legal norms. This study examines how Maja Labo Dahu, the Bima philosophy of social and spiritual accountability commonly expressed as shame and fear, is recognized and normativized in Bima Regency and Bima City. Using a qualitative socio-legal design, the study combines doctrinal analysis of six national legal instruments, selected regional regulations and planning documents, and ten semi-structured interviews conducted in 2025 with six government officials, two customary leaders, and two religious leaders. The data were analyzed through thematic analysis, documentary comparison, and statutory, hierarchical, systematic, and purposive legal analysis. The findings show that Maja Labo Dahu is reflected in a city motto, planning language, and informal governmental programmes but has not been translated into a complete framework of legal duties, competent authorities, sanctions, procedures, and remedies. The study defines this condition as an institutional void, signifying normative, institutional, and procedural absence rather than the absence of cultural recognition or government activity. The study proposes a legally bounded Hybrid Sanction Mechanism that combines voluntary …

abstract: Ushbu maqolada hududlarda innovatsion siyosatning iqtisodiy mexanizmini shakllantirish muammolari va istiqbollari tahlil qilingan. title: Yoruba Folktales as a Mechanism for Conflict Resolution and its Implications for Alternative Dispute Resolution in Ikorodu, Lagos State
abstract: Conflict is an inevitable feature of human interaction, but the methods employed to manage it are culturally conditioned. Among the Yoruba, folktales constitute an important form of indigenous knowledge through which values, norms, expectations and acceptable patterns of social behaviour are transmitted across generations. This paper examines Yoruba folktales as mechanisms for conflict prevention, management, reconciliation and peace building, with particular attention to their implications for Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) in Ikorodu, Lagos State. The study adopts a qualitative documentary approach, drawing on scholarly literature on Yoruba oral tradition, indigenous conflict management, traditional institutions and ADR, together with documentary materials concerning Ikorodu's historical and traditional institutions. The analysis demonstrates that Yoruba folktales perform preventive, corrective, communicative and reconciliatory functions. Through narratives involving justice, greed, betrayal, cooperation, deception, restitution, patience and communal responsibility, folktales teach disputants and community members how destructive behaviour produces social consequences and why reconciliation is necessary for restoring communal equilibrium. The study argues that the narrative logic of Yoruba folktales can complement contemporary mediation and community-based ADR in Ikorod…

title: A carbon dots-doped europium-MOF for dual-signal ratiometric fluorescence and colorimetric detection of flumequine
Dams not to blame for all reservoir carbon emissions from retained organic carbon
abstract: Dams trap organic carbon (OC) and create carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) and methane (CH 4 ) emission hotspots within reservoirs, underlying the ongoing debate over their role in carbon emissions. However, even without dams, this labile OC would still decompose and emit CO 2 or CH 4 during downstream transport and after deposition in estuaries. Thus, relying solely on dammed reservoir observations to assess these emissions may introduce considerable bias. Here, we simulated both dammed and non-dammed scenarios for 5346 global reservoir dams to assess their impact on carbon emissions from retained OC. The results show that reservoir-only approaches overestimate dam-induced carbon emissions by neglecting baseline emissions under no-dam conditions. After baseline correction, dams increase carbon emissions by an average of 21.5% in CO 2 -equivalent (CO 2 -eq), which represents only 18.6% of the emissions estimated using the conventional reservoir-based accounting approach. XGBoost identified reservoir depth and hydraulic residence time as the primary controls on dam-induced carbon emissions.

title: Engineering bacterial morphology through MreB remodeling enhances one-carbon metabolism for sustainable bioproduction
abstract: The actin-like cytoskeletal protein MreB controls bacterial cell morphology, yet whether engineered modulation of MreB-associated architecture can improve microbial metabolism remains largely unexplored. Here, we established a chemical-genetic platform in Escherichia coli combining an engineered MreB variant (A53R) that remodels cellular morphology with A22-mediated perturbation of MreB dynamics. MreB(A53R) reshaped cell morphology and engaged an RpoE-Cra-GadE regulatory network associated with cellular adaptation, which remodeled electron transport, redirected carbon flux toward NADPH-generating pathways, and reduced intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS). Consequently, engineered strains exhibited enhanced formaldehyde tolerance and efficient assimilation of methanol and other C1 substrates. Acute A22 treatment recapitulated the morphological alteration but failed to induce metabolic rewiring, revealing a two-stage adaptive response involving immediate physical adaptation associated with cell envelope reinforcement and long-term transcription-dependent metabolic adaptation to persistent morphological remodeling. The analogous V45R mutation in the native methylotroph Bacillus methanolicus partially recapitulated the improved C1 utilization phenotype, supporting the transferability of MreB-based morphological engineering. title: Carbon Dioxide Sequestration Potential of Rice (Oryza Sativa) Plant
abstract: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) is a naturally occurring component of the atmosphere, comprising approximately 0.04% of atmospheric gases. In recent years, increasing atmospheric CO₂ has received significant attention because of its potential influence on global climate patterns. Anthropogenic activities, including industrialization, deforestation, forest degradation, and fossil fuel combustion, have contributed to increased atmospheric carbon levels and disrupted the global carbon cycle. Plants play an essential role in this cycle by serving as carbon sinks in terrestrial ecosystems. Carbon stored in plants is largely represented by their biomass, with above-ground biomass constituting a major portion of the terrestrial carbon pool. Estimating plant biomass is therefore important for determining carbon storage capacity and assessing carbon loss associated with deforestation. This study investigated the above-ground biomass and carbon dioxide absorption of rice plants, particularly their stems and leaves, and compared carbon capture during the vegetative and reproductive stages. The study was conducted in the Water Quality Analysis Laboratory using 21 samples of rice plant stems and leaves. Results showed that the leaves absorbed more carbon dioxide (0.74739 kg) than the stems (0.64011 kg), which may be attributed to the leaves’ primary role in photosynthesis and their greater availabilit…

title: The origin of UV emission in extremely low-mass satellite galaxies: Insights from Leo T
abstract: The Leo T Milky Way (MW) satellite is the lowest-mass gas-rich galaxy known to exhibit recent star formation. This highly dark matter-dominated system provides an ideal laboratory for studying star formation in the ultraviolet (UV) regime within an extreme, low-density, and metal-poor environment. We present a far-ultraviolet (FUV) study of Leo T using observations from the Ultraviolet Imaging Telescope (UVIT). Our goals are to characterize the properties of FUV star-forming clusters (SFCs), identify FUV-emitting stars, constrain their physical properties through comparison with existing catalogs, and investigate how star formation proceeds in an extremely low-mass, metal-poor galaxy. We examined the FUV extent of the galaxy and compared it with the H, distribution. We extracted thirty SFCs and derived their properties, including area, luminosity, and star formation rate (SFR), and compared them with previous studies. Far-ultraviolet-emitting stars and their stellar parameters were identified through cross-matching with catalogs from the Hubble Space Telescope and the Multi Unit Spectroscopic Explorer (MUSE). We also estimated the global SFR and star formation efficiencies associated with previously identified CO clouds. i The FUV luminosities of the SFCs confirm the absence of massive O- and B-type stars in Leo T. abstract: วิกฤตการณ์การเปลี่ยนแปลงสภาพภูมิอากาศเป็นภัยคุกคามทั่วโลกที่มีสาเหตุหลักมาจากการปล่อยก๊าซคาร์บอนไดออกไซด์ผ่านกิจกรรมทางเศรษฐกิจ โดยเฉพาะการขยายตัวของภาคอุตสาหกรรมอย่างต่อเนื่อง ดังนั้นบทความนี้จึงมีวัตถุประสงค์ 1) เพื่อวัดระดับความซับซ้อนสีเขียวของกลุ่มความร่วมมือทางเศรษฐกิจ 2) เพื่อศึกษาความสัมพันธ์ระหว่างการขยายตัวทางเศรษฐกิจและปริมาณการปล่อยก๊าซคาร์บอนไดออกไซด์โดยใช้แนวคิดสมมติฐานเส้นโค้งสิ่งแวดล้อมของคุซเน็ตส์ในกลุ่มความร่วมมือทางเศรษฐกิจ 3) เพื่อศึกษาปัจจัยที่มีผลต่อปริมาณการปล่อยก๊าซคาร์บอนไดออกไซด์ในกลุ่มความร่วมมือทางเศรษฐกิจ การศึกษานี้ใช้ข้อมูลพาแนลที่ได้เก็บรวบรวมจากกลุ่มความร่วมมือทางเศรษฐกิจ 4 กลุ่ม โดยครอบคลุมในช่วงปี ค.ศ. 2012 ถึง 2022 โดยใช้แบบจำลอง Panel Kink Regression ผลการศึกษาพบว่า ระดับความซับซ้อนสีเขียวของกลุ่มความร่วมมือทางเศรษฐกิจในภาพรวมมีค่าเฉลี่ยอยู่ที่ร้อยละ 6.348 โดยกลุ่มสหภาพยุโรป (EU) และองค์การเพื่อความร่วมมือและพัฒนาทางเศรษฐกิจ (OECD) มีความสัมพันธ์สอดคล้องตามแนวคิดของเส้นโค้งสิ่งแวดล้อมคุซเน็ตส์ โดยปัจจัยทางด้านการใช้พลังงานหมุนเวียนและความซับซ้อนสีเขียวส่งผลต่อปริมาณการปล่อยก๊าซคาร์บอนไดออกไซด์ในทิศทางตรงกันข้าม นอกจากนี้ คุณภาพของสถาบันที่ดีในกลุ่มประชาคมเศรษฐกิจอาเซียน (AEC) และผลกระทบของรายได้ภายหลังนโยบายข้อตกลงปารีส ยังเป็นปัจจัยสำคัญที่ช่วยลดปริมาณการปล่อยก๊าซคาร์บอนไดออกไซด์ลงได้ ดังนั้น ภาครัฐควรมีมาตรการกระตุ้นการลงทุนด้านการวิจัยและเทคโนโลยีสีเขียวมากขึ้น เพื่อยกระดับโครงสร้างการผลิตสินค้าสีเขียว ตลอดจนปฏิรูปคุณภาพสถาบันให้โปร่งใสเพ…

title: Energy and Carbon Footprint of Artificial Intelligence: Measurement, Disagreement and Mitigation
abstract: Estimates of the energy used by artificial intelligence are widely quoted and rarely agree with one another. This review examines why. We separate what is counted (training or inference, operational or embodied emissions, carbon or water) from how it is counted (meters, software trackers, calculators, retrospective estimates, life cycle assessment), and then set published figures side by side with their scope. The best-known early number, an outside estimate for one architecture search, was later put by the operator at one eighty-eighth of that value. One measured study that drew its boundary wider found idle power and manufacturing roughly doubling the footprint of a training run. Inference energy per thousand queries spans three orders of magnitude across tasks. At data-centre scale the AI-specific figures are scenarios built on analyst estimates, and their author says so. We then review mitigation through smaller models, better hardware, scheduling by place and hour, and reporting, and we look at the rebound argument. The article is a review of published work. No new measurement or experiment is reported, and each number is attributed to the source that produced it.

Interference-Controlled Nonclassical Photon Emission via Cavity-Mediated Spin Exchange
abstract: Abstract The generation of nonclassical light with strong photon antibunching and appreciable brightness remains an important goal in quantum technologies. Here, we demonstrate that cavity-mediated spin-exchange interactions provide a route to overcome this constraint by amplifying spectral anharmonicity. In a two-emitter cavity-QED system with a controllable relative phase φ , the resulting interference-interaction mechanism reshapes the dressed-state manifold and enables switching between distinct quantum emission regimes. For φ = 0, constructive interference yields highquality single-photon emission with near-perfect antibunching, suppressing g 1 (2) (0) by more than three orders of magnitude while maintaining a substantial intracavity photon population. Conversely, for φ = π , destructive interference suppresses direct single-photon excitation and selectively enhances two-photon excitation, producing signatures of correlated two-photon emission with appreciable intracavity photon populations and suppressed higher-order excitations. Our work establishes interference-engineered interactions as a mechanism for the controllable selection of single-photon and photon-pair emission, opening new opportunities for programmable nonclassical light sources and quantum photonic applications.

title: Evaluation of deep learning models for optimised accuracy-emission trade-offs in the early detection of grain discolouration disease in rice
abstract: Rice (Oryza sativa L.) constitutes a primary food source for a significant proportion of the global population and its grain quality directly influences market value and consumer acceptance. Grain discolouration (GD), largely attributable to seed-borne pathogens and occasionally to insect infestation, poses a critical challenge by compromising visual quality and reducing commercial grade. This study evaluated the performance of advanced deep learning models for automated detection and classification of discoloured rice grains, incorporating criteria related to predictive accuracy, computational requirements and environmental sustainability. Among the assessed architectures, DenseNet121 exhibited the highest accuracy (98 %), followed by MobileNet (96 %) and MobileNetV2 (92 %), each demonstrating strong precision, recall and F1 scores. In contrast, VGG19 recorded comparatively lower accuracy (84 %). Computational and energy analysis revealed that DenseNet121, MobileNet and Xception required shorter training durations and lower computational resources, whereas MobileNetV2 and InceptionV3 were comparatively resource-intensive. Notably, MobileNet demonstrated superior energy efficiency, consuming 19.03 watts and generating 0.00952 kg carbon dioxide (CO₂), whereas InceptionV3 consumed 377.27 watts and emitted 0.18864 kg CO₂. Atomic-scale facet-defect coupling enables spatially confined electron accumulation in ZnIn 2 S 4 for reductive photocatalysis
abstract: Atomic-scale regulation of photogenerated electrons remains a central challenge in reductive photocatalysis because highly reductive electrons are intrinsically prone to rapid recombination and spatial delocalization. Although crystal-facet engineering and defect modulation have independently improved photocatalytic performance, their synergistic coupling in governing electron accumulation and carrier kinetics remains poorly understood. Here, we report a facet-defect coupling strategy that enables spatially confined electron accumulation in ZnIn 2 S 4 through preferential exposure of high-index {102} facets. Density functional theory calculations reveal that the {102} facets simultaneously have a more negative conduction band minimum and intrinsically lower sulfur vacancy formation energy than conventional {110} facets, thereby coupling enhanced reduction thermodynamics with spontaneous defect generation. Guided by these predictions, an ethanol-glycerol–mediated solvothermal strategy was developed to stabilize the high-energy {102} facets via surface-energy regulation. title: Hydrophobic modification regulates the water microenvironment at the interface of Cu-based materials to promote E-CO 2 RR
abstract: Electrocatalytic CO2 reduction (E-CO2RR) powered by renewable energy is vital for carbon cycling and carbon neutrality. Cu-based catalysts uniquely produce multi-carbon (C2+) products, yet the interfacial water microenvironment and reaction kinetics remain poorly understood. This work fabricates hydrophobic HY-Cu2O (100) catalysts by self-assembling octadecanethiol on cubic (100)-faced Cu2O nanoparticles to tune interfacial water. Integrated characterizations, electrochemistry, and in situ Attenuated Total Reflection Surface-Enhanced Infrared Absorption Spectroscopy (ATR-SEIRAS) reveal how hydrophobicity regulates E-CO2RR performance. Hydrophilic/hydrophobic contact-angle measurements reveal that the surface wetting angle changes from 46.1° (hydrophilic) to 133.5° (hydrophobic). X-ray diffraction (XRD) confirms that the crystal structure remains unchanged. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) results demonstrate that the Cu-S coordination environment of the material is modified. Further inference suggests that the formation of Cu-S bonds verifies the successful functional grafting of octadecyl chains onto the Cu2O (100) surface, which alters the surface hydrophilicity/hydrophobicity without inducing any variation in the crystal structure.
